title: session-load counts file reads per process class from an fs_usage capture the operator makes
goal: python3 _tools/benchmarks.py run session-load --fs-usage FILE reads a capture of fs_usage -w -f filesys, starts no replay and no model, and writes per process class (by the process name each line ends with: python3 kb-tools, git, lsof, claude, fseventsd, else other) and for all a file_reads row (open for reading, read, pread and RdData lines; writes left out) and a distinct_paths row, case 'capture <class>'; without --fs-usage the scenario prints the sudo fs_usage command the operator runs by hand beside it, and no check or run of the tool calls sudo

run:

import os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, 'bin'); os.mkdir(B)
mark = os.path.join(T, 'sudo-ran')
for name, body in (('claude', 'exit 1'), ('sudo', 'touch "' + mark + '"; exit 1')):
    open(os.path.join(B, name), 'w').write('#!/bin/sh\n' + body + '\n')
    os.chmod(os.path.join(B, name), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'run', 'session-load', '--arms', 'D', '--reps', '1', '--out', os.path.join(T, 'out.csv')],
                   capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=1800)
ran = os.path.exists(mark)
shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
assert p.returncode == 0, ('run session-load --arms D exit', p.returncode, p.stderr[-400:])
assert [ln for ln in (p.stdout + p.stderr).splitlines() if 'sudo fs_usage' in ln], 'the run names no sudo fs_usage command for the operator'
assert not ran, 'the run called sudo'

clauses.clause: python3 _tools/benchmarks.py run session-load --fs-usage FILE reads a capture of fs_usage -w -f filesys, starts no replay and no model

writes left out) and a distinct_paths row, case 'capture <class>'

gates.question: Which arm label do the rows of a capture carry (the goal names the case 'capture <class>' only)?
gates.reason: an empty arm would make a same-day run of the replay arms (or of a capture) replace the other's rows of the record

gates.question: How is a process name classed: any python is kb-tools, exact git, lsof, claude, fseventsd, else other?
gates.reason: macOS runs the interpreter as python3, Python or python3.N, and the name carries no script to tell kb-tools from other Python

gates.question: Are rows written for a class that has no line in the capture, and does an open that failed (errno) count as a read?
options: write no row, skip failed opens
gates.reason: a fixed row set per capture shows a class that read nothing, and the goal counts open lines for reading by mode

gates.question: Where does --fs-usage run: with session-load named alone (else exit 2), or beside other scenarios?
options: any scenarios, the others run as usual
gates.reason: the flag must start no replay and no model, and another scenario named would start paid runs
